title: Annual Leave Policy
body: Employees are entitled to 20 days of annual leave per year. Leave must be requested at least 3 days in advance and approved by the manager.

title: Sick Leave Policy
body: Employees may take up to 8 days of sick leave per year without documentation. More than 3 consecutive days requires a medical certificate.

title: Casual Leave Policy
body: Each employee receives 6 days of casual leave per year for non-planned time off. Casual leave cannot be taken in the first year of probation.

title: Remote Work Policy
body: Staff may work from home up to 2 days per week with manager approval. All remote days must be logged in the attendance system.

title: Expense Reimbursement Policy
body: Travel and training expenses are reimbursed within 15 working days when a receipt and approval form are submitted within 30 days of the expense.

title: Employee Benefits Policy
body: Employees qualify for health insurance after 3 months of employment. Annual performance reviews determine bonus and raise eligibility.

title: Resignation Notice Policy
body: Employees must give 30 days written notice when resigning. Notice period may be reduced at management's discretion.
